task: Add a resizable separator between chat history and chat prompt input so users can drag to resize the prompt area height.

key_reasoning.reason: Three components touched across two UI sub-layers: ChatPage (layout refactor to introduce Panel/Group), ChatPrompt (remove hardcoded min-h-32/max-h-64/h-fit height classes), ChatHistory (change grow to h-full), plus a new useChatPromptResize hook. Pattern is established in WorkflowDetailsPage and useWorkflowDrawer.

Core pattern (react-resizable-panels Group/Panel/ResizableSeparator + localStorage persistence via useDefaultLayout) is fully exercised twice in the codebase. Residual risk comes from the -translate-y-3 visual overlap on ChatPrompt that must be removed and replaced, the h-fit/shrink-0 classes that must become h-full, and the conditional rendering logic (Panel split only when ChatHistory is present).
